player_prompt.intro: O n ṣere {difficulty} RushHour puzzle. Slide cars to free the red car [X] ki o si fi i silẹ ni eti ọtun. Awọn iṣe: [A+], [B-], ati bẹbẹ lọ. (+ = siwaju, - = sẹhin).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ìṣe tí kò léwu. Lo ọ̀nà [A+] / [B-].

game_message.solved: Ọkọ̀ pupa náà ń sún mọ́lé!
